title: Booking
description: Travel booking reservation with user, booking type, reference number, check-in/check-out dates, total cost, and status. Used for hotel bookings, travel reservations, and accommodation management systems.

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who made the booking

type.description: Booking type (e.g., hotel, flight, car_rental, tour)

reference.description: Unique booking reference number or confirmation code

status.description: Booking status (e.g., confirmed, pending, cancelled, completed)
